notes: Gold evidence uses source_anchor_id sub-paragraph spans from source_span_seed_refs.json; live dogfood uses spref paragraph spans reconciled via line/char overlap.
Multiple nodes may share anchor evidence; span-overlap fuzzy matching is the intended live-vs-gold comparator — not exact node_id equality.

Re-grounded gold treats entity quality as corpus resolvability: NPC/PC/location nodes carry corpus_ref objects that resolve through the live reference indexes when a corpus hub exists, while sublocations, factions/groups, and creatures without hubs use resolution=proposed with stable review slugs.

The Last Dry Bed is represented as proposed sublocation ref_id=the_last_dry_bed on the inn-common-room node, cross-referenced to the Maera Vell innkeeper hub; Session 23 source grounds the inn/common-room debate but does not itself name Maera.

The edge layer was rebuilt around durable structural/semantic relationships (member_of roster, located_in containment, governs, parent_of, leads, displaced_from, threatens, part_of, knows_about). Moment-by-moment combat actions remain in session beats rather than relationship edges.
